chargement: Reading what is kept on the phone

illisible.titre: The library has not been loaded yet
illisible.texte: Document titles come from the library, which has never been loaded on this phone. It will load when the network returns.
illisible.texte-en-ligne: Document titles come from the library, which could not be loaded. Open it to try again.

telephone.vide: No documents downloaded. A document is downloaded from its page, to read offline; it stays on this phone, not on your account.
telephone.impossible: This browser does not report how much space Guide Négo uses: it cannot be measured on this device.
telephone.persistance-refusee: This phone has not granted permanent storage for documents: if it runs out of space, it may erase them. You will then need to download them again.
telephone.orphelines: And {count} document that is no longer in the library: it will be erased the next time the library is refreshed. | And {count} document that is no longer in the library: it will be erased the next time the library is refreshed. | And {count} documents that are no longer in the library: they will be erased the next time the library is refreshed.

favoris.rappel: A favourite can be read without a network only if it is also downloaded.
favoris.vide: No favourites. Tap “Favourite” on a document's page to find it here, on all your devices.
favoris.sans-compte: Favourites follow your account from one device to another. Create an account or sign in to add some; downloads do not need one.
favoris.connexion: I already have an account — Sign in
favoris.pas-encore-lus: Your favourites have not been loaded on this phone yet. They will load when the network returns.

tout-retirer.reste: The library and your favourites stay.
tout-retirer.question: Remove {count} document from the phone? | Remove {count} document from the phone? | Remove {count} documents from the phone?
tout-retirer.un: {document} will no longer be readable without a network. It stays in the library, and your favourites do not change.
tout-retirer.un-sans-compte: {document} will no longer be readable without a network. It stays in the library.
tout-retirer.plusieurs: {documents} will no longer be readable without a network: {taille} in all. They stay in the library, and your favourites do not change.
tout-retirer.plusieurs-sans-compte: {documents} will no longer be readable without a network: {taille} in all. They stay in the library.
tout-retirer.fait: Document removed from the phone. | Document removed from the phone. | Documents removed from the phone.
tout-retirer.orphelines: {count} document that is no longer in the library ({taille}) | {count} document that is no longer in the library ({taille}) | {count} documents that are no longer in the library ({taille})
tout-retirer.attente: The requested download of {documents} is cancelled too. | The requested download of {documents} is cancelled too. | The requested downloads of {documents} are cancelled too.
tout-retirer.echec: The phone could not remove everything. Close the other Guide Négo tabs, then try again.
